verdict.rationale: Gusto now spans payroll, contractor payments, and business banking, so AP automation is a fair question for this kind of small-business finance platform. However, nothing in the evidence shows vendor invoices being matched to purchase orders, coded to accounts, or routed through a payment approval workflow. The closest item, invoice ingestion that prefills a payroll paysheet, is an adjacent contractor-payroll feature, not purchase-order matching or AP routing, so it earns no credit.
